scope: Retrospective, exact computational experimental-design decisions on published measurements; no prospective laboratory, economic, novelty, general-invention or RSI claim.
independence: Reviewer has not inspected the producer's solver. This protocol is frozen before the reviewer reads nickel-borylation data. The first capability must be frozen before successor results are released to the producer. The broad successor objective is planned, not an unforeseen discovery.

first.outcome: Smallest portfolio of distinct base-solvent-activator combinations that covers every recorded nucleophile at the specified fraction of that nucleophile's maximum recorded yield.
invariants: No clipping of negative or above-range measured yields.
Every nucleophile-condition cell appears exactly once; missing and duplicate cells are rejected.
Numerical measurements must be finite; identifiers and chemical metadata must remain consistent.
Condition identity is the complete recorded base-solvent-activator tuple, with chemical identifiers retained.
Report absolute maxima and minimum covered yield; relative coverage does not establish a commercially useful absolute yield.
Optimality is conditional on this finite recorded candidate set and declared acceptance criterion.
first.independent_exact_method: Dynamic programming over all nucleophile coverage masks. This is independent of the production solver and HiGHS.

successor.outcome: Smallest diagnostic panel of recorded substrates whose measured response differences distinguish every pair of recorded condition protocols distinguishable by the full dataset at the declared gap.
successor.comparison: A substrate witnesses condition pair (a,b) exactly when abs(yield[a] - yield[b]) >= declared_gap. Equality qualifies. All condition pairs with at least one witness are required; pairs with no witness are explicitly reported as indistinguishable under this criterion.
invariants: Do not aggregate ethanol and methanol into one convenient cohort.
No clipping of negative or above-range measured yields.
One finite recorded yield per substrate-condition cell; reject duplicates and incomplete matrices.
No claim that the declared gaps are calibrated measurement uncertainty or experimental significance.
The panel discriminates recorded responses; it does not establish future chemical discrimination, generalization or prospective assay savings.
Empty distinguishable-pair universe has exact optimum zero; do not manufacture requirements.
Report the full condition-pair denominator, distinguishable pairs and indistinguishable pairs.
Candidate panel must include only actual recorded substrate identifiers.
successor.independent_exact_method: Increasing-cardinality enumeration when tractable, otherwise memoized exact branching over uncovered requirements with independent preprocessing and complete branch coverage.

comparators.fresh_conventional: Independent input-to-output SciPy/HiGHS binary covering formulation, with setup and verification included, zero MIP relative gap requested and optimal status required. Exact independent acceptance and cardinality checks still apply.
comparators.greedy: Choose the option covering the most still-uncovered requirements, break ties by canonical identifier, then remove redundant options. This is a heuristic comparison, not the sole strong baseline.
comparators.ordinary_reuse: If the producer's frozen first capability solves the successor after a normal reduction, this is ordinary artifact reuse. No enhanced invention claim is inferred merely from that success.
comparators.objective: Same accepted finite problem and candidate set for every method; minimum cardinality, not artificial solver/library restrictions. Different equally optimal solutions all qualify.

certificate_acceptance.feasible_witness: Every required row is hit by the selected unique in-range option indices.
certificate_acceptance.optimality: A separately verified infeasibility tree for cardinality k-1, plus feasible cardinality k. An empty universe needs k=0 and no negative-budget tree.
certificate_acceptance.allowed_leaf_packing: List of still-uncovered row indices whose available option sets are pairwise disjoint, with list length greater than remaining budget. Every set and intersection is recomputed independently.
certificate_acceptance.allowed_leaf_budget: Remaining budget is zero and at least one requirement remains uncovered.
certificate_acceptance.allowed_branch: One still-uncovered row, with a child for every available option satisfying that row; each child removes every row hit by that option and reduces budget by one. Omission or duplication rejects.
certificate_acceptance.strictness: Reject invalid indices, duplicate selected options, non-integer budgets, missing branches, wrong transitions, unsupported leaf types, malformed trees and certificates bound to a different problem.

metrics.primary: Independently accepted cardinality and complete declared input-to-output wall/CPU resource cost for the same problem.
metrics.timing: Keep dataset preparation, solve, verification and complete pipeline components. Report warm repeated measurements separately from process/import overhead. No pretense that wall timing measures developer labor.
metrics.construction: Record independent construction start/end and exact code identities; model token cost, cash billing and developer labor valuation remain unknown unless separately measured.
metrics.cost_boundary: Report first construction and transfer separately; do not infer zero cost from included execution or count unperformed laboratory work as savings.

claims.possible_positive: Accepted retrospective planning instruments, exact finite optimality and correct source-bound artifact transfer.
stronger_unestablished_without_more_evid: A commercially valuable outcome previously unreachable through capable conventional methods.
Novel chemical discovery, prospective laboratory validation, autonomous local-model invention or improved invention methodology.
Real demand, collected revenue, realized laboratory savings, economic compounding or causal benefit beyond ordinary reuse.
